reason: Successfully navigated to the QA agent, sent a math question message, received a correct response containing "4", and verified agent functionality.
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:47891 — Successfully loaded the app with the Gamut interface showing the sidebar with agent list.
Found the "QA-20261006-204711-iicn" agent in the sidebar — Agent was visible and clickable in the "Your Agents" section.
Clicked on the "QA-20261006-204711-iicn" agent — Successfully navigated to the agent detail page showing agent status as "idle".
Verified agent status is "running" or "idle" — Status showed "idle", which meets the requirement.
Typed message "Hello! What is 2+2?" into the message input field — Message text successfully populated in the input field with data-testid='home-message-input'.
Clicked the "Send message" button — Message was submitted and the page transitioned to a chat session titled "Basic Math Question Session".
Waited for agent response (up to 3 minutes) — Agent processed the request, status changed from "working" to "idle" within approximately 30-60 seconds.
Verified response mentions "4" and took screenshot — Agent responded with "2 + 2 = 4." which clearly contains the number "4" as required. Screenshot captured showing the full conversation exchange.
